root.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Stonewall Variation
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 c6 3. Nf3 Nf6 4. e3 e6 5. Nbd2 Ne4 6. Bd3 f5

overview: Black builds a Stonewall pawn chain with ...c6, ...d5, ...e6 and ...f5 and puts a knight on e4, a Semi-Slav hybrid. White reacts with Bd3, O-O and a pawn break at c5 or f3. The e4 knight controls the centre and the structure favours kingside play for Black and queenside play for White.

white_ideas.idea: Challenge the e4 knight with f3 or Nxe4, then play for c5 and queenside space
Trade the e4 knight and use the e5 hole

black_ideas.idea: Keep the e4 knight and play for ...Nd7/...Qf6 and kingside play
Control e4 with a Stonewall formation

typical_structures.structure: Stonewall for Black with pawns on c6, d5, e6, f5

character.notes: The Stonewall is hard to break down even if Black has a kingside plan. Positional, slow.

structure.notes: A locked Stonewall centre, play moves to the wings.

approach.notes: A branch of the QGD/Semi-Slav rather than a set-up against all.

level.notes: Plans around e4 and e5 matter more than memory.
